x: Controls, your first levels, and tips straight from the game. Controls Touch: move with the joystick, tap the bomb button to drop a bomb, tap the skill button to use your hero's skill. Joystick and button settings are under Settings › Controls. Keyboard: arrow keys or WASD to move, Space to drop a bomb, X for the skill, E to turn the camera. Your first steps Your levels. Swipe to see them all: winning a level opens the next one. Stars show how well you did: one for a win, one for a win without a hit, one for the level's goal. Pick Easy or Normal. Win a level to open Hard mode, then Impossible mode. Energy: every level costs 10 energy. It refills by itself: +1 every minute, up to 100. Boosters, chests and bundles, all on one page. Pick your boosters before a level. Tap back to return to camp. Tips from the game Walk into a bomb to kick it away. Ouch! In this tutorial bombs don't hurt you. But watch out: once we start, they do! Careful: no fence on open edges. Falling off ends your run! Tiles here can collapse at random You found a key! Keys open the chest of their colour. Tap here to open your chests. Daily and Weekly tasks are open! Finish tasks for points, and fill the bar to open its chests.

Six heroes, six superpowers. Every hero drops bombs like Blom, plus one skill of their own. Blom Bomb Dash : Blom dashes ahead and cannot be hit during the dash. How to get Blom: Blom is your first hero: you play as Blom from the start. Dash 3 tiles; 4 tiles from ★5 Cooldown ★1 → ★8 15 s → 8 s Gusto Gust : A blast of wind in front of Gusto pushes enemies and their bombs away. How to get Gusto: Win Level 5 to meet Gusto. That first win gives 10 Gusto portraits and starts a trial of 5 games as Gusto. Collect 20 portraits to unlock Gusto for good. h: Towers, the airship and the castle guards
x: Who you are up against in Green Lands and on Castle Road. Bombers Thorn Guard's bombers play by the same rules as you: they drop bombs, grab power-ups and can be blown up. Twig Scout Places 1 bomb, Quick on its feet. First seen on Level 1 Burr Bomber Places 2 bombs. First seen on Level 3 Bramble Lobber Places bombs, Throws bombs. First seen on Level 7 The boss Thorn Guard Walk over the switch tiles to break its shield! Fights you on Levels 5, 10, 20, 25. Bomb Barrage Aimed Throws Ring Break Level 5 Levels 10, 20, 25 Hits to win 4 10, then 10 more when he gets furious Bombs in a barrage 2 5 Towers, the airship and the castle guards Rage Tower Awake from the start, it shoots arrow-bombs across the board, over stones but not crates. An arrow takes a third of your health. Bomb it from right next to it to bring it down! Takes 3 hits. Range 7 tiles. An arrow takes 34 of your 100 health. Airship Thorn Guard's flying warship. Its cannonballs explode the moment they land, so watch the red markers and step away! Shellback The castle's stubborn doorkeeper. It spins and lobs bombs around itself, and the marks show where they land. Its shell blocks every blast until it walks: hit it while it walks, a bomb in its path! Takes 2 hits. Cobblewatch The castle's spear guards. They walk round the outside of the yard, line up with you, flash a yellow ! and charge straight across in pairs. Step out of their lane, or bomb them: they never dodge. A spear hit takes 34 of your 100 health. How much a blast hurts Everyone has 100 health. The closer you stand to the bomb, the more it hurts: Distance from the bomb 0 tiles 1 2 3 4 Damage 100 50 35 30 25

What drops out of crates, what it does, and where you first find it. A crate you blow up has a 20% chance to drop a power-up. It vanishes after 12 s if nobody takes it. Each level has its own list of power-ups that can drop there. Good power-ups Power-up What it does First level Extra Bomb Place one more bomb at a time. Start with 1, up to 8. 1 Fire Range +1 Your blasts reach one tile further. Blasts start at 2 tiles, up to 8. 1 Speed You run faster. +0.5 tiles a second each, from 4 up to 7. 2 Armor Blocks one hit for a short time. Lasts 8 s. 6 Kick Walk into a bomb to kick it away. 3 Heart Heals you. Heals 40 health. 3 Lightning Strike Tap the lightning button to paralyze enemies for three seconds. 8 Ice Bomb Your next bombs freeze tiles to ice. Ice lasts 5 s. 6 Fire Bomb Your next bombs leave burning tiles. 7 Health Regen Heals 5 health every 1 s for 8 s. – Surprise Box Spin for three power-ups and pick the one you want! 8 Power-downs: avoid these Power-up What it does First level Bomb Down One bomb fewer at a time. Avoid it! 7 Fire Range -1 Your blasts reach one tile less. Avoid it! 7 Speed Down You run slower. Avoid it! 7 Broken Shield Breaks your Armor. Avoid it! 8 Regen Down Blocks healing for 5 s. – Bombs A bomb goes off 3 seconds after you drop it. A bomb caught in a blast goes off too, so one bomb can start a chain. "–" in the First level column: this one is not on any campaign level's drop list in version 1.0.

Bridges, belts, cages, gates and push blocks: what the tiles on the board do. Board tiles Holes Gaps in the ground. You can't walk across, but blasts fly right over them! Falling Tiles Some tiles drop away into the sky. A warning shows first, so step off in time! New Ground Fresh tiles rise up to fill a gap and open a new path. Shifting Rows Whole rows slide sideways, crates and bombs too. The end tile falls off, so don't stand on it! Crumbling Tiles Any tile here can crack and fall. Watch for the warning and move away! Switch Tiles Walk over all the switch tiles to break the boss's shield! Bridge Switch Step on it to raise a wooden bridge across the gap. It stays up for good! Conveyor Belts Belts carry you, bombs and crates along. Ride them, and mind the end where tiles drop off! Reverse Switch Step on it to turn every conveyor belt around. Shrinking Ring The outer ring of tiles crumbles away, again and again. Head for the middle! Cage Enemies wait locked in a cage. Step on its switch to let them out, or it breaks open by itself! Timed Gate Step on its switch and a path rises over the gap, but only for a few seconds. Hurry across! Number Plates Step on the plates in number order to open the way. A wrong step turns them all off! Moving Ground The whole ground creeps along, and the tiles at the back drop away. Keep moving! Castle puzzles Levels 21 to 25 on Castle Road are puzzle levels in stages. The game explains them like this: Stone blocks! Walk into one and keep pushing to slide it a tile. You can't pull it. Push the blocks: two make a bridge over the gap, the third goes on the plate to open the gate. Then walk into the open gate. A stuck block pops back to where it started. Hero powers work in the castle! But a magic wall stops skips: finish the puzzle first. The stage clock The HOURGLASS is each puzzle's CLOCK. Red: hurry! Green: solved! If it runs out, the gate crumbles! Solve the puzzle and the clock stops and disappears. Then take your time! The bell and the runes Step on the first rune to ring the bell: its GATE opens for a few seconds. The bar on the gate counts down. Then step on the next RUNE: it glows in its gate's colour. Blocks only slide while a gate is open. Bridge each gap: a finished part crumbles once you leave it! A castle level gives you some retries.

Boots, Gloves and a Helmet: three slots, nine looks, five rarities. New: Gear! You found your first piece. Wear Boots, Gloves and a Helmet to run faster, blast harder and stay safe. Equip them here and LEVEL UP them with coins; a card's colour is its rarity. Merge 3 pieces of one slot into a stronger one. Rarities and level caps Gear levels belong to the slot, not to the piece: level up your Boots once and every pair you wear counts at that level, up to the cap of the piece's rarity. The three things you collect and spend, and the 28-day login. Energy Energy: every level costs 10 energy. It refills by itself: +1 every minute, up to 100. You start with 100. Watching an ad gives 50 energy (up to 5 times a day). Coins Coins: you earn them by winning levels, and spend them on boosters in the Shop. A first win of a level gives 30 coins, a replay 8, plus 8 for every star. Coins also pay for gear levels and hero stars. Gems Gems are rare. Spend them on upgrades, revives, energy refills and boost bundles. Achievements pay gems, and so does the daily login on some days. 28-Day Login Your daily bonus: a free gift every day. Come back each day to collect it. x: Saves, purchases, refunds and your data. Is my progress saved? Yes. Your progress is saved on your device, and a copy is kept in your iCloud (iPhone and iPad) or Google Play Games account (Android) when you are signed in. Settings › Account › Cloud save across devices keeps the same save on your other devices of the same kind. The Privacy Policy, section 2.8 has the details. I bought something on a new device. How do I get it back? Sign in to the same Apple ID or Google account and tap Settings › Account › Restore Purchases. Permanent purchases such as No Ads come back. See Support . How do I get a refund? Refunds are handled by Apple or Google: see Support . How do I delete my data? Settings › Account › Delete my data. See Support for what it deletes. Are chests random? Every chest names its guaranteed gear piece before you open it, and shows the odds of everything else. See Chests and keys . I ran out of energy. Energy: every level costs 10 energy. It refills by itself: +1 every minute, up to 100. Something else? Mail support@boombaland.com .
